part.text:
The route is now `(Partial Prerender)` — the static shell (`<main>`, `<h1>`, suspense fallbacks) is pre-rendered, and each component's data streams in independently.

Changes:
- **`app/page.tsx`**: dropped the top-level `await`; the page is now sync and renders the static shell with three `<Suspense>` boundaries.
- **`app/CardStats.tsx`**, **`app/RevenueChart.tsx`**, **`app/LatestInvoices.tsx`**: each became an async component that fetches its own slice of data, so failures/slowdowns are isolated and each streams in parallel.

Wins:
- TTFB stays static (shell ships from cache).
- Parallel data fetching — chart and invoices no longer wait on each other.
- One slow endpoint doesn't block the rest of the UI; the fallback for that section shows immediately.
